limitations: Historical test already observed; no new blind test or expert gold.
Memorization proves optimization on 16 examples only.
Three matched seeds and fixed folds do not exhaust training/sampling uncertainty.
Architecture comparison includes pretrained-vs-from-scratch representation and parameter-count differences.
Length shortcut and external rules are diagnostics; never neural input features.
Rejection failure is separate from four-class prediction accuracy.
Ensemble analyses are secondary; they cannot replace the predeclared primary family comparison.
